integrity: Proved algebraically for the published two-pressure switching ODEs, with transformed positive parameters retaining the g_r=1 normalization; checked by symbolic identities and an exact rational within-bound fit transformation. The initial equilibrium and every output path are preserved. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Locomotion-only output; an independent absolute-pressure measurement can destroy the exhibited observational equivalence.
No result on whether the six reduced combinations are themselves all globally identifiable.
Physiological correctness, new experimental data, and statistically optimal estimation are not addressed.
The preprint v1 date is verified through its indexed posting information; the full publisher-hosted open journal text is the version used for detailed equation-level comparison.
title: An exact observational gauge in the seven-parameter amoeba habituation model
